summary: The Figma pilot stays a thin layer over the generic runtime and now reports configured-but-unproven Figma as auth_failed instead of connected.

findings.message: The Figma pilot boundary isolates detection of the Figma remote server and computes an honest initial status without changing the generic HTTP runtime contract.
The MCP preset now uses the Figma pilot status to render the indicator and `/mcp` output, preventing a false connected state when only config exists.
The targeted Figma suite proves both config recognition and honest visible failure reporting.
